gaps.sentence: Only in an emergency ___ this exit be used.
gaps.explanation: may + be + participle: this exit may be used only in an emergency.

gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ we seen such dedication from a new recruit.
gaps.explanation: 'Rarely have we seen' — inversion with present perfect, experience up to now.

gaps.sentence: Only later ___ it occur to her that the letter had been a forgery.
gaps.explanation: 'Only later' at the front inverts with do-support: did it occur to her.

gaps.sentence: Only when the last guest had left ___ she sit down.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when … had left did she sit down' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: Not until the following morning ___ the damage reported to the police.
gaps.explanation: 'Not until + time' triggers inversion: 'was the damage reported'.

gaps.sentence: Little ___ they know that the deal had already collapsed.
gaps.explanation: Little did they know = they had no idea — emphatic idiom with inversion.

gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ this metro line run this late.
gaps.explanation: Rarely at the front: does + subject + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: Only when the results were published ___ the scale of the error become clear.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when … did the scale … become clear' — inverted past simple.
